newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan puts 1995/96 budget gap at 5.8 pct of GDP.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan puts 1995/96 budget gap at 5.8 pct of GDP.

text.p: Pakistan's budget deficit in the 1995/96 financial year rose to about 5.8 percent of gross domestic product (GDP), the central bank said in its annual report released on Thursday.
"The latest estimates indicate that the budget deficit was 5.8 percent of GDP in 1995/96 (July-June)," the central State Bank of Pakistan said in its report.
It said the government had originally aimed to cut the deficit to 5.0 percent from 5.6 percent in 1994/95, but had changed the target to 4.6 pct in the second quarter.
"Notwithstanding the substantial resource mobilisation effort made in the beginning and the middle of the year, the budget deficit target for 1995/96 could not be achieved," the central bank said.
